notes.text:
This update for libosmocore fixes the following issues:

Changes in libosmocore:

- Update to release 1.14.2
  * Fix buffer overflows/overreads in `bssgp_rx_paging`,
    `parse_process_uss_req`, `osmo_dec_gcr`, `osmo_pbit2ubit`, in
    the CBSP WRITE-REPLACE decoder, and in TLV tag logging.
    [boo#1289028, CVE-2026-104592]
  * iuup: Cure stack buffer-overflow rx IuUP with payload
    larger than 1024 bytes. [boo#1289027, CVE-2026-104591]
    [boo#1288875, CVE-2026-104597]
  * gsm: Reject BSSMAP Encryption Information IE with no selected
    algo or key length != 8.
  * Resolve [boo#1289029, CVE-2026-104594]
